text:
alex: Corpcard got a soft-decline at the inflight snack cart on AA flight 237 — vendor shows a 'tap-to-pay' hold and the printed receipt is just 'AMT $14.75'. Manager approved but we don't have an itemized receipt. Is a screenshot of the bank pending txn + boarding pass OK to submit?

marta: Hi Alex — usually we need merchant name, amount and date. Airline receipts are messy. If you can pull the in-app receipt from AA or a screenshot of the card txn that usually works. @finance tagging in case of edge-case.

dave: We accept slim receipts for small travel purchases. If charge posts and manager signs off we can make an exception. For audit please add a brief note in the expense form stating why itemization is missing. Did the charge post or still pending?

alex: It's still pending on the bank: screenshot attached (shows "AA-INFLIGHT" and $14.75). Boarding pass uploaded to the expense.

tia: Upload everything to Expensify, tag project "ENG-SRE" and category "Meals - Travel". In the notes put: "Manager-approved: Marta" and paste Marta's Slack confirmation if possible. :+1:

marta: I confirm approval for this purchase — manager-approved for expense exception.

alex: Done — screenshots + boarding pass uploaded. Expense ID 8791. Pasted Marta's confirm here too.

expensebot: Expense 8791 submitted. Status: pending-review. Missing: itemized merchant receipt flagged. If manager-approved, reply with the exact phrase `manager-approved` to record exception.

marta: manager-approved

expensebot: Exception recorded. Finance will process once the charge posts. Expect resolution in 3-5 business days. If the corpcard charge does not post, submit a personal-card reimbursement request and attach the boarding pass + proof of manager approval.

dave: Adding note for the team: for inflight purchases < $25 we can accept bank SMS/pending txn + boarding pass + manager approval as a standard exception. Documented here for auditors.

alex: Awesome — thanks everyone, saved me a stressful queue at the gate :sweat_smile:
